artifact.name: skia-build-mac-universal-gpu-release.zip
artifact.legal_files_note: The sealed asset contains no license or notice file. Its content-addressed legal manifest is a separate asset of the same release, covered with the archive by the builder's build-provenance attestation; NOTICE.md reproduces the license texts it resolves.

skia.evidence: The release's legal manifest records this commit as the checked-out Skia revision (source_revisions.skia), and that manifest is covered with the archive by the builder's build-provenance attestation. The asset itself does not embed this exact Skia commit.

dawn.evidence: The legal manifest records this Dawn checkout (source_revisions.dawn) and build/include/dawn/dawn_version.h embeds the same 20-byte commit.

builder.evidence: The build-provenance attestation for the archive was signed by build-skia.yml on refs/heads/main at this commit (skia-builder run 40626447857, attempt 1, GitHub-hosted).

headers.digest_command: from build/include: find . -type f -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256

observed_macho.evidence_limit: These values are observed LC_BUILD_VERSION data from representative object members, not a proof that every member has the same tuple.

bundled_components.name: ICU
bundled_components.license: Unicode-3.0 and bundled third-party notices; see NOTICE.md

bundled_components.name: libjpeg-turbo
bundled_components.license: IJG AND Zlib; BSD-3-Clause applies to the TurboJPEG API/build system, which was not identified among the libskia archive members
bundled_components.binary_evidence: libjpeg.*, libjpeg12.*, and libjpeg16.* archive members

bundled_components.name: Abseil
bundled_components.binary_evidence: absl:: global symbols and Abseil implementation members such as raw_hash_set.cc.o and crc32c.cc.o

bundled_components.name: PartitionAlloc
bundled_components.binary_evidence: partition_alloc:: global symbols and allocator implementation members such as low_level_alloc.cc.o

bundled_components_completeness.method: the builder's content-addressed legal manifest, re-derived against every zip member and every static-archive member and symbol table of the locked archive

identity_limits: Release eligibility rests on skia-builder's own records: the build-provenance attestation, the legal manifest and the toolchain receipt. No Vellum-side signature is added.
The exact Skia and builder commits are not embedded in the asset; they are bound through the attested legal manifest and the attestation's source commit. Only the Dawn commit is embedded.
The legal manifest resolves each file's license to its nearest ancestor license file; it does not adjudicate license compatibility.
The legal manifest's GN target graph was not captured for this build (gn ls failed); object-to-source mapping comes from the build's dependency files.
The artifact is not claimed reproducible from source.
Archive membership proves packaged object code, not that every member is retained by the static linker's dead-code selection in a particular provider or frontend binary.

developer_supplied_prerequisites: Xcode command-line tools and system JavaScriptCore for macOS

historical_seed_dependencies.note: Historical font and NanoSVG blobs remain reachable only through Git history and the immutable extraction record.
